content.text:
The bug was in `rb_push` in `src/ringbuf.c`. It wrote at `len % cap` and ignored `head`, so once the buffer had wrapped, new values landed in the wrong slot. It now writes at `(head + len) % cap`.

`make test` now passes with 118 checks and 0 failures. I didn't change anything under `tests/`.
